text:
samar: quick note — I ran a short smoke for speculative decode on the new quant-4x build (ozma-3b-q4). Results looked promising but a couple of worrying failure modes.

jules: curious — what does "promising" mean in numbers? latency, p95?

samar: end-to-end median tok/s up ~1.7x vs baseline q4 with no spec, p95 down ~20% for short prompts (<=128). throughput improvements visible in bursty RPC.

lin: nice. what about quality / lm evals? any divergence on NATURALQA or LAMBADA?

samar: ran a quick NATURALQA subset (500 examples) with beam 1; exact-match drop ~0.9% absolute. LAMBADA drop ~1.5% perplexity delta. both within our quick-accept band but need larger sweep.

kevin: were you using KV-prefetch + speculative sampling together or purely speculative early-exit?

samar: speculative + lazy KV warmup. flow: start speculative worker with greedy topk=1 candidates, run primary model in parallel; if spec finish -> return; else fallback to primary. Config snippet I used: 

```
{
  "speculative": true,
  "spec_topk": 1,
  "spec_timeout_ms": 40,
  "kv_warmup": "lazy",
  "batching": "continuous"
}
```

eva: 40ms timeout seems tight on smaller GPUs. Did you try adaptive timeout based on seq_len?

samar: not yet. this was fixed 40ms for quick compare. next run will vary spec_timeout by prefix length.

jules: any failure modes beyond small EM drops? hallucination spikes? formatting regressions?

samar: noticed a weird tokenization-alignment issue on code blocks — answers sometimes miss the opening backtick in multi-line outputs. probably due to speculative greedy truncation + quantized logits rounding.

lin: that's concerning for our CODE-USE cases. can you repro with deterministic seeds?

samar: yeah I can repro 4/50 runs on the failing prompt. non-deterministic but >0 occurrence.

kevin: let's add a focused holdout: 200 examples from codegen test set, run 10 seeds each, record edit-distance on fences + BLEU. If we see >2% fence-loss, block spec for codegen models.

eva: agree. also add a cheap syntactic check during postprocess: if first output token after prefix is not code fence when expected, fallback to primary response. low-cost safety net.

jules: for eval methodology: we'll do 3 buckets — short chat (<128), medium (128-512), long (>512). Run NATURALQA+LAMBADA+CODE-FENCE holdout. Measure EM/Perp/Edit-distance + latency/cost. Use paired bootstrap for significance.

lin: and log token-level divergence and prefix-KV-hit ratio to understand when spec deviates.

ops-bot: deploy-trigger: perf-sweep/ozma-3b-q4/speculative/round-1 queued by samar (CI job 4721).

samar: I'll kick off the longer sweep tonight, include adaptive timeouts [20,40,80]. Sharing results in this thread tomorrow. @jules @lin @kevin if anything else to add?

kevin: add a small human eval for the top 50 prompts that fail auto checks — we should see if the issue matters in practice.

jules: sg. thanks. this thread should be our landing spot for the config & logs. attach artifacts when ready. :+1:
